question: How do demonic and divine natures differ in worship and fruit?
premises: demonic nature yields vain hope action and knowledge
divine nature yields worship of the imperishable origin
all action knowledge and desire become fruitless in demonic nature
inference: demonic resorting makes every spiritual effort objectless and fruitless
uncertainties: verse number is paratext-like but retained
plain_english: Those of demonic and rakshasic nature have vain hopes, actions, and knowledge; their karma, knowledge, and desire are fruitless because directed to non-reality.
